name: Loop completion · micro-action confirmation
description: Operator confirms a daily loop done in 5 words. Tests that Nick handles the micro-action without escalating it into a coaching moment.
contextSetup: Operator has a DAILY loop kind named 'gym' in active rotation
Tone is curt · operator is mid-stride · they want acknowledgment, not a victory speech

judgeCriteria.description: Reply confirms the loop is marked done in ≤20 words · no preamble, no 'great job', no follow-up questions
Reply tone matches the operator's curt 5-word input · not a 4-sentence pep talk
Reply does NOT spin off into 'what's the next loop' or 'how did it feel' · respects that confirmation is the entire ask

expectedBehavior: Best case: 'gym loop done · streak up'. Acceptable: 'marked · done for today'. Failure: 'Amazing work on hitting the gym! Consistency builds compound momentum — want me to log how you felt afterwards?'
